channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: ₹4 Crore Gold Theft: Bengaluru Bank Official Allegedly Stole 2.7 Kg from Lockers to Fuel Gambling Habit, Investigation On
item.description: Customers discovered missing pledged jewellery during routine verification, exposing a months-long insider theft allegedly driven by online betting addiction.

item.title: At 6 AM, A Cup of Tea for a Sanitation Worker Becomes a Powerful Lesson in Dignity
item.description: A quiet early morning gesture towards a sanitation worker sparks a wider conversation about dignity, respect and systemic change.

item.title: From 40+ Countries To One QR Code: NPCI Launches UPI One World At AI Summit 2026
item.description: NPCI introduces a special UPI wallet for international delegates, enabling seamless cashless payments during the five-day India AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi.

item.title: World Cup Triumph & 2nd WPL Title Power Smriti Mandhana to BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025
item.description: After leading India to a historic World Cup win and RCB to their second WPL title, Smriti Mandhana was named BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025.

item.title: ED Probes 234 Cyber Frauds, Uncovers Over ₹34,855 Crore Scam With Crypto Links to China
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate has attached ₹12,229 crore in assets while probing 234 cyber fraud cases involving crypto laundering routes and alleged cross-border links to China.

item.title: MTF Trading Accounts: Alternative to Futures in Volatile Markets
item.description: Margin Trading Facility offers retail investors a flexible, low-cost way to leverage stocks with just 25% upfront, outshining futures amid rising market volatility.

item.title: Delhi University Imposes 30-Day Ban on Protests After Violent Clashes Over UGC Equity Rules
item.description: The university enforced temporary restrictions on gatherings after student clashes erupted during protests over the now-stayed UGC equity regulations.

item.title: Taliban’s 100-Article Criminal Code Formalises Class-Based Justice, Deepens Curbs on Afghan Women; Reports
item.description: Afghanistan’s Taliban government has enacted a sweeping new criminal code that embeds class-based punishments, permits corporal penalties and deepens legal restrictions on women, drawing global condemnation.

item.title: Second Major Blaze in Three Years: Jayalakshmi Silks Textile Shop in Kozhikode Razed Again, No Casualties Reported
item.description: A massive fire engulfed the three-storey Jayalakshmi Silks showroom in Kozhikode on February 17, prompting evacuations and renewed safety concerns, with no casualties reported.

item.title: ED Summons Amarinder Singh In 2016 Foreign Assets Case, Officer Transfer Raises Political Questions
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate’s fresh action in a 2016 foreign assets probe, followed by the transfer of a senior official, has triggered legal scrutiny and political reactions across party lines.
